worldcombat.skill.confide.summary: Whisper to a selected foe or a nearby world point, briefly lowering at most one body's Sp. Atk. Sound crosses cover; after losing sight, companions only use the last position seen within three seconds. A body that leaves that point may be missed. The drop ends with its distraction window; speak and move on.
worldcombat.skill.confide.use.0: Blunt a special attacker from behind cover
worldcombat.skill.confide.use.1: Blunt a high-Sp.-Atk threat's next hit
worldcombat.skill.confide.use.2: Speak, then immediately return to your own offence
worldcombat.skill.confide.description.0: The whispered target loses %1$s Sp. Atk stage(s) and stays distracted for %2$s; the drop is tied to the distraction window and is fully restored when it ends, is cured, or is reapplied. When the drop cannot land (immunity or the floor), no success is reported.
worldcombat.skill.confide.description.1: Hearing range: %1$s blocks. Select one body or a world point; point casts choose the nearest hostile body within 0.6 blocks of that point, at most one. Sound needs no line of sight. AI uses a last-seen point for three seconds and never tracks hidden movement.
worldcombat.skill.confide.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
The companion only considers speaking while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it at point-blank, larger starts sooner.
Countering speaks only while the enemy attacks the companion or its owner, or right after a hit; Anytime speaks at any threat.
On: favours targets whose Sp. Atk exceeds their Attack, saving the debuff for real special attackers. Off: treats every not-yet-distracted enemy the same. This only changes which target it picks.
When on, the companion may leave its post to confide under a Hold order.
